description: TicketWeb is a Ticketmaster-operated self-service ticketing, marketing, and event-management platform for independent venues and promoters. Custom website integrations use Ticketmaster's Discovery API, whose public datasets include TicketWeb-sourced listings across North American and international markets. Transactional offers and near-real-time inventory status are separate partner or authorized-client APIs.
